title: Short-circuit diagnostics for shadow rollout failure and automation follow-ups
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: During a shadow rollout of a quantized model variant (q8) behind the serving runtime, we observed repeated token-dropouts and elevated 5xx rates in production for a subset of tenants. Shadow traffic was enabled at 30% sampling; however, automated rollback did not trigger because the shadow telemetry path missed aggregated error-rate signals. This ticket captures diagnostics, immediate mitigations, and the follow-up runbook + automation work to prevent recurrence.
incident_timeline: 2026-02-16 10:02 UTC - Canary health checks green. 10:18 UTC - First alert: per-tenant token error spike on region us-west-2. 10:24 UTC - Ops scoped to requests that hit models/variant-q8. 10:28 UTC - Shadow traffic throttled to 5% and sampled to full logging. 10:34 UTC - Observed KV cache miss amplification when shadow path shared cache keys; reverted routing to pin to baseline models. 10:45 UTC - Full revert completed. 11:00 UTC - Post-incident data collection started.
root_cause_summary: Telemetry gap: shadow path metrics were emitted to a different ingestion stream that lacked the aggregated 1m error-rate rollup used by the auto-rollback engine. Secondary contributor: shared KV cache keyspace between baseline and q8 variant caused unexpected cache eviction patterns under continuous-batching, increasing latency and token dropout risk for shadow-coupled requests.
steps_taken: 1) Emergency throttled shadow sampling and pinned production routing to baseline. 2) Hotfix: temporarily duplicated shadow metrics into the primary aggregation stream. 3) Reverted the rollout for all affected tenants. 4) Collected request traces and KV cache metrics for 48 hours for offline analysis.
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: implement a telemetry contract and conservative safety net for shadow traffic rather than disabling shadow testing. Tradeoff: initial rollout safety layers add ~3-6ms p95 latency due to extra sampling hooks and metric duplication, but prevent multi-minute blind spots for auto-rollback. Also decided to isolate KV cache keyspace per variant (adds memory overhead on GPUs).
proposed_runbook_updates: - Add a 'shadow telemetry contract' checklist that requires aligned error, latency, and p99 token-drop metrics emitted to the auto-rollback aggregation stream. - Define a mandatory synthetic-canary run after any change that shares KV cache keys across variants. - Add step to throttle or pause shadow traffic automatically if cache pressure exceeds threshold. - Document escalation to SRE if auto-rollback signals are missing for >2m during a rollout.
automation_tasks: - Implement metric-forwarding shim to ensure shadow metrics are present in rollback engine (owner: SRE, due: 2026-03-05). - Add hysteresis and sample-weighting into rollback decision logic so small measurement gaps don't block fallback (owner: runtime-team, due: 2026-03-18). - Add a routing circuit breaker in the smart router to instantly divert a higher percentage of traffic away from new variants when KV miss rate or token-drop rate exceeds thresholds (owner: routing, due: 2026-03-22).
synthetic_and_chaos_work: Create a synthetic workload that reproduces KV cache churn at scale and run as part of the pre-rollout gating. Design a short chaos experiment that toggles cache keyspace sharing in staging to validate automatic throttles and rollback triggers (owner: reliability, estimate: 3 points).
monitoring_and_alerting_changes: - New rollup metric: 'rollout.shadow.error_rate_1m' emitted by all variant paths. - Dashboard: per-tenant shadow vs baseline drift view. - Alert: missing shadow rollup stream for >90s triggers P0 to SRE and blocks canary promotion.

review_feedback: - PM (Priya Shah): prioritize Console UX change so customers see 'shadow-safe' badge. - Design (Marco Li): keep telemetry UI simple and add a 'why blocked' tooltip. - Security (Nina Alvarez): confirmed KV keyspace isolation does not expose additional secrets but requested review for memory limits.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Shadow telemetry contract is implemented and validated in staging. 2) Rollback engine consumes shadow rollup metrics and triggers within configured SLOs in a synthetic test. 3) KV cache isolation prototype validated under synthetic churn. 4) Runbook updated and linked from Console rollout UI.
notes: We observed this class of failure only when continuous-batching and shared KV caches interact with quantized kernels; long-term fix may involve kernel-level safeguards. This ticket targets operational safety and observability to prevent future blind windows during rollouts.
